name: EPIC 206409744
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 12.1 solar radii and 1.41 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,464 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.41 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,694 K at its surface.
